name: AUTOPILOT.OI Review Desk
description_html:
Every review, answered. In your voice.

Paste a review, type reply. Good reviews get a warm thank you. Bad ones get a calm, professional answer that won't make things worse, plus a private note of what to check first. It also writes the short text that asks your customers for a review.

How it works: you add the guide to a free Claude Project, paste one message, answer 7 easy questions, then type one word whenever you need it. It drafts; you decide.

What you type: reply · bad · ask · batch · week

What you get (13 page guide, PDF): a setup helper that asks 7 easy questions and sets it up with you in about 15 minutes, tap by tap on your phone, how to find your Google review link, a worked example and a cheat sheet.

You need: the Claude app (the free plan works) and your Google review link.

Drafts only: you post every reply. It never writes fake reviews or offers rewards for reviews. 30 day refund: reply to your receipt.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or Google. Claude is a product of Anthropic.
